Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left.
Complaints centered on neck and low back pain with associated muscle guarding and reduced range of motion. The
reported mechanism of injury is consistent in type and magnitude with the force of the impact described. Imaging and
physical examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical and lumbar regions. No prior injury or
treatment to the same body areas is known to this provider. Care was delivered over 13 visits, consisting of manual
therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. The course of treatment ran somewhat longer than is
typical for a strain of this severity, reflecting a gradual but steady response. Billing records reflect single charges for
each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated billing observed. Patient was discharged with a home exercise
program and advised to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
